scope: Three bounded comparisons; no complete Rhetorius54 audit

comparisons.topic: Age timing from planets versus angles

ptolemy.statement: Seven sequential universal planetary ages with stated durations.

rhetorius.statement: ASC first age, MC middle, DSC last and IC death/posthumous matters, with subphases. Holden equates this chapter with Porphyry52.

comparisons.relation: Different structures and reference frames, not an interchangeable age-clock. Shared word age does not establish equivalence.

ptolemy.statement: Universal ages use Moonabout4, Mercury10, Venus8, Sun19, Mars15, Jupiter12, Saturnremainder.

rhetorius.statement: Least years are Moon25, Mercury20, Venus8, Sun19, Mars15, Jupiter12, Saturn30. Complete years are a separate set; Holden offers recurrence explanations.

comparisons.relation: Four nominal lengths match but Moon/Mercury/Saturn differ in the universal age sequence. Recurrence/table uses are not the same technique; the Mars note explanation differs without independently settling astronomy.

comparisons.topic: More than one time origin and topic-specific parents

ptolemy.statement: Five topical origins and annual counting from each.

rhetorius.statement: Count years not only from ASC but Sun, Moon, Fortune, plus parent Lots when the parents are present.

comparisons.relation: Both resist ASC-only reduction, but origin sets and applications differ. Do not silently add the parent Lots to Ptolemy or collapse natal quality and timing topics.
